AuthorMetricsEnrichRequest.description:
Body of ``POST /internal/author_metrics_enrich`` — a title/concepts digest
of the author's recent works, built by the Go gateway.
AuthorMetricsEnrichRequest.title: AuthorMetricsEnrichRequest

AuthorMetricsResponse.description:
``POST /internal/author_metrics_enrich`` — the LLM-scored metric bundle.

``GET /author_metrics`` itself is served by the Go gateway now
(decisions/0010); Python only runs the enrichment step. Shape:
``topic_toughness``/``velocity``/``overall_score`` ints, ``skills``/``tools``
string arrays, ``analysis`` string. ``extra="allow"`` keeps it a passthrough.
AuthorMetricsResponse.title: AuthorMetricsResponse

info.description:
Research intelligence backend powering the SkoLab Android app.

**Auth**: Protected endpoints require a Firebase ID token in the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header.

**Rate limits**: enforced per-IP by the Go API gateway in front of this service, not here.

get.description:
Dynamically brainstorms and queries industry-academic tie-up ideas
based on the user's semantic memory profile and recent active topics.
Each idea is enriched with real academic papers searched on OpenAlex.

Owner-scoped: reads the caller's private semantic-memory profile, so the
verified Firebase uid must equal ``user_id`` (see docs/backend-auth-posture).

post.description:
LLM enrichment for ``GET /author_metrics`` (served by the Go gateway).

Takes the title/concepts digest the gateway built and returns the scored
bundle. Raises 503 (``AIUnavailable``) if the LLM step fails — the gateway
degrades that to an empty bundle on its side.

get.description: Dynamic status check verifying database and cache connectivity.

Liveness probe — the process is up. Makes NO dependency calls, so a DB
or cache blip never triggers an orchestrator restart of a healthy pod.
Readiness probe — should traffic route here? 503 drains this instance.
